description: Mastercard Incorporated is a technology company in the global payments industry, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, digital partners, businesses and other organizations worldwide by enabling electronic payments and making those payment transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. It makes payments easier and more efficient by providing a wide range of payment solutions and services using its family of well-known and trusted brands, including its primary brand Mastercard, as well as its Maestro and Cirrus brands, and it operates a payments network that provides choice and flexibility for consumers, merchants and its customers, and through its unique and proprietary global payments network it switches, or authorizes, clears and settles, payment transactions, with additional payments capabilities that include automated clearing house transactions, both batch and real-time account-based payments.
